FAQs

Electrical Questions, Answered

What people ask before they ring, answered by Gary.

Consumer Units and Rewires Faults and Testing EV, Solar and Outbuildings About GMW

Consumer Units and Rewires

Does my consumer unit need replacing?

The two usual reasons are a unit that's out of date and one that shows signs of damage. If yours is either, a replacement is normally a 1 day job.

How much does a consumer unit cost?

Consumer unit replacements start at £700 plus VAT. The final price depends on what we find when we look at yours.

Do I need a rewire?

As a general guide, old rubber or fabric covered cable, round pin sockets and a fuse box with rewirable fuses are all signs of old wiring. An electrical installation condition report will tell you for certain.

How much does a rewire cost?

There is no set figure: it depends on what you need from the rewire and how easy the cables are to get at. We look at the house first, then price it.

Faults and Testing

My lights keep tripping, can you help?

Yes. One recent call was a lighting circuit that kept tripping and wouldn't reset. Water was getting into an outside junction box, and finding and fixing it took 2 hours. See our lighting work.

My sockets keep tripping, can you help?

Yes. A trip means something on that circuit is at fault, and we test the circuit until the fault shows, then repair it.

How much is an EICR?

An electrical installation condition report starts at £120 plus VAT, depending on the property type, its size and where it is. More on our inspection and testing page.

EV, Solar and Outbuildings

How much to install an EV point?

From £900 plus VAT, depending on the survey. Most installs are around half a day, and we're an OZEV approved installer and an Ohme Approved installer. See EV charge points.

Do you install solar panels and battery storage?

Yes. We hold City and Guilds 2922-34 Solar Photovoltaic systems and City and Guilds 2923-34 Battery storage, and every system is planned around the property using known, proven components.

Can you wire my garage?

Yes. A garage needs its own supply run out from the house, then sockets and lights inside. We did an outbuilding supply in Wymondham this year. See extensions and outbuildings.

Can you wire my summer house?

Yes. Tim in Narborough has had us wire glamping pods and garden offices, and a summer house is done the same way. Read his review on our reviews page.

About GMW

Are you registered and insured?

We're NAPIT registered, and we hold public liability insurance with cover of £5,000,000. More about us on the about page.

Do you guarantee your work?

Yes: 12 months on all labour/ workmanship.

Which areas do you cover?

We're based in Norwich and cover Wymondham, Dereham, King's Lynn and Fakenham, plus the villages around them. See every area we cover.

What are your working hours?

8am to 6:30pm. Call 07576 485671 or send a WhatsApp and Gary will get back to you.
